title: JIN: Kakutoha Oden
synonyms: Jin: Legend of the Dipper Style Destruction King
synopsis: In the not-too-distant future... In a society where corruption has spread and dreams and hopes have disappeared, an illegal, no-rules underground fighting sport called "Yaoyorozu" has thrived. Brutal street fights are waged anywhere and everywhere, driven by money and human desire. Jin Matsuya, a delinquent who repeatedly steals from the city, gets caught up in the violence. However, his qualities as a fighter are overwhelming... A new generation of spectacular battle action begins, where an extraordinary monster destroys everything! (Source: Kodansha, translated)

synopsis: Code Geass: Oz the Reflection is a spinoff published in Hobby Japan magazine and Kadokawa Shoten's Newtype Ace magazine. It tells a story from the viewpoints of two different protagonists. The story takes place between the first and second seasons of the TV anime and is told from two perspectives. The photo story in Hobby Japan centers around Orpheus Zevon (Jivon), a young terrorist with the Knightmare Frame (KMF) Byakuen who is in pursuit of his lover's killer. The manga in Newtype Ace revolves around Oldrin Zevon, a girl in the Britannia Empire's anti-terrorist unit Glinda Knights who pilots the KMF Lancelot Grail. (Source: Code Geass Wiki)

synopsis: Seiya Tonami is an office worker in his late twenties. His Friday night routine involves relaxing with a drink, alone at his favorite standing bar. But one day, after coming to the rescue of a college girl who was getting unwelcome attention at the bar, he finds himself sitting next to her every week. From small-talk about daily life to lighthearted complaints… Even though it's just casual conversation, it's so nice to have someone beside you, having a laugh together — it's a romantic comedy that makes you look forward to those Friday nights at the bar, where you feel free to get a little tipsy. (Source: Manga UP!, translated)
